review_evidence: README identifies the repository as Advent of Code 2022 solutions written in Lean 4, built and run as day-specific executables.

A complete declaration scan over its 36 Lean files found 291 declaration-style implementation items but only one proposition declaration: List.length_split_of_atLeast2 in Aoc/Lib/Mergesort.lean, used to justify recursive mergesort termination.

The remaining Day<N> modules are parsers, data structures, search routines and puzzle computations with IO entry points; there is no independently stated puzzle specification, correctness development, or reusable theorem corpus.

source_action.content_invariant: The source consists of executable Advent-of-Code puzzle implementations. Its single theorem is a local mergesort termination helper, so removing the repository does not hide an independently addressable formal specification, theorem development, or reusable formal interface relevant to prior-art search.
